claims.assertion: Yazhi frames positive emotions as integration with the Source and negative emotions as separation; she calls emotion a compass but says logic must navigate obstacles.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: Positive feelings still require perspective and logic.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says all souls have emotions, but Andromedan and Arcturian ranges are narrower than Lyrian; Taygetans may have emotional range comparable to or greater than humans.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi says logic-focused Federation mentors may misread human emotional decisions; she names Taygetan, Engan, and Solatian societies as better-suited mentors.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
